description: Architecture Tournament V3 — Production Architecture Selection Experiment. 7 arms (M0-M4C) × 100 problems, fresh runs, frozen routing policy, V2 ontology, common downstream gates.

arms.M0: MACRO_ONLY — broad evidence discovery + synthesis, no Micro knowledge
arms.M2: MACRO_TO_MICRO — Macro produces mechanism memory (round 0), Micro consumes it
arms.M3: MICRO_TO_MACRO — Micro produces problem memory (round 0), Macro consumes it
arms.M4: RECURSIVE_MACRO_MICRO — 4 rounds of alternating frozen knowledge exchange
arms.M4B: INFORMATION_MATCHED_NON_RECURSIVE — same accumulated info as M4, non-recursive
arms.M4C: COMPUTE_MATCHED_NON_RECURSIVE — same total compute as M4, non-recursive

winner_threshold: M4 > M4B AND M4 > M4C AND M4 >= best_baseline + 5pp AND stats pass
invariants: All 7 arms use the SAME frozen routing policy
All 7 arms use the SAME V2_FROZEN ontology
All 7 arms use the SAME 100-problem universe
All 7 arms use the SAME Phase D frozen evidence packets
All 7 arms use the SAME downstream gates (target alignment, evidence verification, prior-art, adversarial, AIC)
No arm gets architecture-specific threshold leniency
No prior Macro-1 or Micro-2 outputs are reused as tournament results

Every candidate carries full provenance (architecture_origin, arm, round, problem_id, provider, model, prompt_hash, source_hashes, evidence_spans, prior_art_state, adversarial_state, AIC_state, simulation_state)
